repos_data.description: Open-source MCP server bridge for PDF Content Search — full-text PDF search + OCR for Claude/Cursor across thousands of documents.
A fast, local, indexed code search tool optimized for AI coding assistants. Written in Rust using Tantivy for full-text indexing.
It falls out of your notch. Hotkey, repo, Return: your terminal opens with Claude Code, Codex or any agent already running. Free, MIT, local...
Private search and Q&A for your documents. One binary that watches your folders and answers questions with citations, fully local.

repo_meta_data.description: Windows-native full-disk search: file names, document contents, and text inside screenshots. Acrylic command palette on Alt+`. Rust · tantivy · Tauri. 本地全盘搜索：文件名、文档内容、截图文字。
